query:
SELECT library_id AS "library!", plugin AS "plugin!",
                              backdrop AS "backdrop!", ids AS "ids?: String",
                              title_sources AS "title_sources!"
                       FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY library_id
                                                          ORDER BY added DESC, item_id DESC)
                                           AS newest
                             FROM (SELECT *, IIF(kind = 'movie',
                                                 MIN(added_at) OVER title,
                                                 MAX(added_at) OVER title) AS added
                                   FROM (SELECT library_files.library_id, library_items.id AS item_id,
                                                library_items.kind, library_items.added_at,
                                                item_matches.backdrop_plugin AS plugin,
                                                item_matches.backdrop, libraries.title_sources, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS listed_id, (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS ids
                                         FROM item_matches
                                         JOIN library_items
                                           ON library_items.id = item_matches.item_id
                                         JOIN library_files
                                           ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
                                         JOIN libraries
                                           ON libraries.id = library_files.library_id
                                         WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched')
                                   WINDOW title AS (PARTITION BY library_id, listed_id))
                             WHERE backdrop IS NOT NULL)
                       WHERE newest = 1
